dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides many expert‑only details (root access‑key bypasses MFA, master‑switch overrides IAM, Cost Explorer must be enabled before CAD, CAD region‑pinning, budgets quota, free‑tier alerts routing, console‑only aws-portal actions, etc.) that go beyond a generic model’s knowledge.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Provides an AWS‑specific, ordered procedure (pre‑flight, step‑wise classification, confirmation gate, remediation steps) with exact CLI commands. Minor loss for occasional generic phrasing (e.g., "check security") that could be tighter.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Comprehensive NEVER list with concrete reasons (e.g., AdministratorAccess does NOT grant billing, never treat root keys as non‑critical, never use wrong API for root MFA) and clear operational impact.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Complete frontmatter, clear description, explicit when‑to‑use, robust activation triggers, and a well‑defined invocation schema.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Information is layered (quick reference, then deep sections) but the document is dense; some critical rules (e.g., member‑account handling) are buried deep, causing slight cognitive overload.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions are tightly gated (confirmation prompt, note on irreversibility of root‑key deletion), while read‑only/creative steps are left flexible.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable structure (Mindset → Quick reference → Pre‑flight → Process → Output → Anti‑patterns → Safety → Remediation) that aids comprehension.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides a complete decision tree, exact CLI snippets, error handling for incomplete snapshots, and worked examples; minor omission of pagination/error‑code handling prevents a perfect score.
